jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

jobs.occupation: Lead Contract Engineer Nuclear Pressure Equipment (M/F/X)
jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Internship - Digitalization & AI for Wiper Blade Testing
jobs.description:
Your challenge

Join our wiper blade test department and help us make our testing processes smarter, more standardized and data-driven. You will work on practical digitalization and AI solutions together with our test engineers.

Your main tasks

• Test specification standardization
• Compare existing wiper blade test specifications and identify opportunities for complexity reduction.
• Standardize test descriptions and required information.
• Develop an AI-based solution to easily compare specifications and highlight differences.
• AI for test reports
• Develop an AI solution to search and analyze historical test reports.
• Investigate how the quality and structure of existing data can be improved.
• Create a standardized template for future test reports to enable effective AI-based analysis.
• Digitalization of test equipment
• Update the test equipment inventory, including equipment locations.
• Support the preparation and entry of equipment data into the new laboratory management system planned for 2027.
• Wiper arm digitalization & 3D scanning
• Create an inventory of available wiper arms and link them to the existing wiper arm library.
• Support the digitalization of wiper arms using 3D scanning.

• Bachelor or Master student with a technical/engineering background, for example mechanical, automotive, electromechanical or industrial engineering.
• A strong interest in digitalization and Artificial Intelligence.
• An analytical and structured way of working.
• Motivation to work with technical specifications, test reports and engineering data.
• Good communication skills and the ability to work closely with test engineers.
• Good written and spoken English, as you will work with technical specifications, reports and colleagues in an international environment.

PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
 

Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of 
PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
 

About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
 

Your Mission: as a 
PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
 

 
 

Your Responsibilities:
 

Compliance & Conformity Management
 
 

• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation. 

• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects. 

• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables. 

• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities. 

• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.  

Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
 
 

• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes. 

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers. 

• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths. 

• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.  

Operational Readiness & License to Operate
 
 

• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution. 

• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation. 

• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks. 

• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and operational release. 

Education & Experience
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline. 

• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects. 

• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management. 

• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset. 

• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.  

Knowledge & Affinity
 

You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
 
 

• European product legislation and conformity assessment; 

• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles; 

• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF); 

• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness; 

• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements; 

• Occupational safety and statutory inspections; 

• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.  

Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
 

Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
 

Competences
 
 

• Translate complexity into structure and action. 

• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders. 

• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities. 

• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills. 

• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery. 

• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.  

Languages
 
 

• Dutch: Fluent 

• English: Professional proficiency 

• French: Strong asset  

You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.

We are looking for an experienced engineer with strong expertise in engine emissions, powertrain development and aftertreatment systems who wants to broaden that knowledge into independent vehicle homologation. You will lead international type approval projects, act as a technical reference for emissions-related topics, and progressively develop competence across other vehicle systems and regulations.  Key responsibilities
    
• Lead vehicle and component homologation projects from quotation and planning through test witnessing, technical assessment, documentation and certification follow-up.  
• Witness tests at manufacturer sites and accredited laboratories; critically review results, technical reports and supporting evidence in accordance with applicable procedures.  
• Provide specialist expertise in heavy-duty engines, emissions, OBD/OBM, anti-tampering, aftertreatment systems and non-road mobile machinery (NRMM).  
• Assess compliance with applicable EU and UNECE frameworks, including EU 2018/858, relevant emissions legislation and EU Stage V requirements.  
• Develop competence beyond emissions, progressively taking on other regulatory domains such as braking, steering, electromagnetic compatibility, vehicle safety and cybersecurity/software updates.  
• Coordinate directly with OEMs, suppliers, laboratories and type approval authorities, including authorities in Belgium, Luxembourg, Sweden and other European countries.  
• Prepare and independently review structured technical dossiers, inspection reports and certification documentation under Vinçotte quality procedures.  
• Identify commercial opportunities, build long-term client relationships and contribute to efficient, consistent working methods within the team.  
• Share specialist knowledge with colleagues and support internal training and technical development.   
International travel – an essential part of the job  
  
Frequent international travel is a core requirement, not an occasional exception. Assignments may last 2–5 consecutive weeks, sometimes longer depending on project needs, particularly at customer and test facilities in Japan, Korea, India and other manufacturing locations. Candidates must be comfortable working independently abroad, adapting to customer schedules and multicultural environments.

  
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in mechanical, automotive or related engineering.  
• Substantial experience in engine development, emissions testing, calibration, aftertreatment, OBD/OBM, certification or related automotive engineering activities; heavy-duty and NRMM expertise is a strong advantage.  
• Sound technical understanding of emission control technologies (e.g., DOC, DPF, SCR, EGR) and the ability to interpret technical test data.  
• Experience with type approval or regulatory certification is preferred; candidates from OEM engineering are welcome if motivated to learn the independent technical service perspective.  
• Willingness to learn and apply a broader range of EU and UNECE regulations beyond the candidate's initial specialization.  
• Strong technical judgment, impartiality, attention to detail, autonomy and disciplined documentation.  
• Confidence communicating with international clients, colleagues and authorities; strong English skills. Dutch or French is required in line with the existing position profile.  
• Based in Belgium or willing to relocate, and available for frequent extended international travel.
